usage: 橡膠 usually functions as a noun referring to rubber as a material.
It can describe both natural and synthetic rubber.
橡膠 is often used to talk about items or products made from rubber.
You can combine 橡膠 with other nouns to specify types of rubber products, e.g., 橡膠手套 (rubber gloves).
It can also be used in compound words related to rubber materials.
